We develop an LLM-based framework to simulate how humans perceive seismic risks, as illustrated in Figure . By integrating rich pre-event contextual information, the LLMs are tasked with "reasoning" the likely severity of damage across spatial scales.
datasets: Multimodal earthquake dataset (USGS, OpenStreetMap, ACS, Google Street View)
outputs: reasoning trace and MMI rating predictions
Free-text reasoning explanation and predicted Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) level
LLM generates a reasoning trace and an MMI rating in JSON format: {"Reasoning": "<Provide reasoning>", "MMI": "<Respond MMI level>"}
